The challenge we solve
Brands need marketing momentum — not another management headache.

An in-house marketing department can involve multiple hires, recruitment time, salaries, training, tools and ongoing management. That commitment may not fit every stage of a growing business.

Marcketers brings selected marketing capabilities together through one flexible partnership. We help you understand your market, shape a practical plan, identify relevant creators and coordinate agreed campaigns — with scope based on your goals and budget.

Reduce hiring overhead

Access agreed support without recruiting every role internally.

Bring work together

Connect research, creators, content and reporting.

Make informed choices

Use market and campaign insights to guide priorities.

Stay focused

Spend less time coordinating disconnected tasks.

Influencer intelligence

The biggest audience isn't always the right audience.

We start with your brand, product, customer and campaign objective. Then we evaluate creators on the factors that matter to your campaign — not just a follower-count screenshot.

The scorecard below is an example framework. We adapt the criteria to each campaign and the information available.

A practical creator scorecard

Illustrative weighting for a first shortlist

Audience relevance25%
Engagement quality20%
Content quality15%
Audience geography15%
Previous conversion evidence15%
Brand compatibility10%

Our working process

Five steps. From understanding to improvement.

We never pick creators before we understand the brand. Each stage builds on the one before it.

01

Discover

Understand your product, business goals, target audience, budget and constraints.

02

Research

Review your category, competitors, customer signals and relevant creators.

03

Plan

Recommend priorities, channels, concepts, deliverables, timeline and measurement.

04

Coordinate

Carry out agreed work and coordinate creators or contributors within scope.

05

Measure & Improve

Review results, share learnings and recommend practical next steps.

What you receive

Clear deliverables, agreed before work begins.

Depending on the project or monthly scope, your partnership may include practical outputs like these — with responsibilities and timing confirmed in writing.

ReachImpressionsVideo viewsEngagementLink clicksLanding-page visitsLeadsConversionsOrdersAttributed revenueCPAROAS

Which metrics apply depends on the campaign and tracking setup. Revenue is not the same as profit. Reliable attribution needs suitable tracking, accurate inputs and agreed reporting rules.
